description: This file contains C source code implementing HTTP range request parsing for the libwebsockets library. It includes functions for parsing, validating, and managing byte-range headers as specified in RFC7233, used for partial content delivery in HTTP responses.

methods.name: int lws_ranges_next(struct lws_range_parsing * rp)
methods.description: Parses the next range header segment to determine if it represents a valid range and updates the parsing state accordingly.

methods.name: void lws_ranges_reset(struct lws_range_parsing * rp)
methods.description: Resets the range parsing state to initial values for a new parsing cycle.

methods.name: int lws_ranges_init(struct lws * wsi,struct lws_range_parsing * rp,unsigned long long extent)
methods.description: Initializes range parsing, extracts the range header from the HTTP request, and counts the valid ranges based on the content extent.

ctags.name: lws_ranges_init
ctags.signature: (struct lws * wsi,struct lws_range_parsing * rp,unsigned long long extent)
